title: Fix ReplanGovernor to use ITimeProvider instead of UtcNow
description: P1 finding from 2026-07-11 audit (MSA-INFRA-001): ReplanGovernor uses DateTime.UtcNow directly instead of injected ITimeProvider. This prevents deterministic testing. Inject ITimeProvider and use it for all time-based decisions (stall timeout, auto-recovery). Source: Data/Pages/Audits/codebase-audit-20260711-10agent-swarm-5chair-council.md

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: **Scope expanded by internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11):** The ITimeProvider gap is wider than originally scoped. The merged finding (P1-001) now includes: (1) ReplanGovernor — 3 UtcNow instances, (2) WorldState.IsInventoryFresh — Sprint 60 regression, (3) WorldModel — 4 UtcNow instances in constructor/Observe/ApplyOutcome, (4) ActionOutcome — all 7 factory methods. See TSK-0394 for the batch implementation task that supersedes this scope.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Scope superseded by TSK-0394 (Done). The batch ITimeProvider injection covers ReplanGovernor, WorldState, WorldModel, and ActionOutcome. ReplanGovernor now accepts ITimeProvider? with SystemTimeProvider.Instance default. Recommend closing TSK-0371 as superseded.
